newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1997 FDI seen over $12 billion.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1997 FDI seen over $12 billion.

text.p: Foreign direct investment in Brazil will be above $12 billion in 1997, Altamir Lopes, the head of the Central Bank's economics department, said.
"Direct investment will be above $12 billion," Lopes told reporters.
Foreign direct investment (FDI) in the first quarter of 1997 reached $2.899 billion versus $1.261 billion in the same year-ago period.
The government plans to privatize mining giant Companhia this month with a $3.0 billion block sale of 40-45 percent of the company's voting shares.
The government is also auctioning cellular B Band concessions which are expected to raise about $5.0 billion in license fees.
